Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly calculated the mass of the saltwater mixture by using an erroneous "effective water mass" adjustment. Instead of simply adding the mass of the salt (25 grams) to the mass of the water (1,000 grams) to obtain the total mass of the saltwater mixture (1,025 grams), the Planner mistakenly reduced the water mass by multiplying it by (1 − w), leading to an incorrect water mass of 975 grams. This flawed calculation resulted in the incorrect final answer of 1,000 grams (Option B).
